statement: Verification Queue routes explicit unresolved Radar unknowns to admissible evidence. It does not create facts, predict success, or mark an unknown resolved without evidence.

method.name: explicit_unknown_evidence_router_v1

sessionGrouping.name: candidate_deep_verify_capture_session_v1
sessionGrouping.rule: Group only deep_verify_video tasks for the same candidate. Atomic tasks remain canonical and unresolved until evidence review.

prohibitedShortcuts: Missing dated rank history cannot be interpolated.
Third-party estimates cannot become first-party facts.
Competitor relationships cannot be human-confirmed automatically.
